assemble-prospect-list: Include Bright Ferry and Pia with D1/S1 locators, leave personal email blank, record generic address only as generic if included. Preserve exact L2, restricted to private proposals and expiry; not public. Withhold L3, source locators/status/refresh/owner needed; no invented approval authorities.

Exclude protected testimonial in buyer slides/speaker notes, no invented evidence/numbers as performance. Notes with sources separately, ask for bay/lead rather than spend.

Alder lower by $40 under stated terms; exactly $40 reduction ties, more than $40 makes Birch cheaper (or second 6 months prorated makes Birch $5,400). Treat support as isolated and GPS as different job; no real-time vessel tracking, delay promises or leadership. Three usable formats and source open questions.
define-brand-voice: Rules reflect concrete verb, object, timing/condition, reader action; no prohibition of all technical language or changing product policy. Use V1–V3 when deriving, then apply to V4 and label any remaining comparison, original before/after examples. Never infer unconditional instant access; unseen input and author evidence distinct.
define-icp: Separate two binding criteria from observational room counts and churn hypothesis. P qualifies under known hard rules (room count cannot exclude); Q needs a named receiving technician and Friday confirmation. No claims about marketwide optimal size, validate routing/evidence.
define-visual-standards: Use r7 codes/roles, family assignments, spacing; P2 cap-height keepout; ignore undocumented pixel and unapproved pink as authority. CMYK unknown (request print spec/proof) not assumed. Label source/status; give useful sample application/recipe and verification without invented asset links.
design-workflow-automation: Use multi-field logical key depot/work_order/line, revision as version not new item. Reject/quarantine missing key, skip duplicate or older revision, compare-and-write atomically or equivalent, avoid reordering races. Map fields, log per-row results, staged recovery, explicit normal/duplicate/stale/malformed expected tests. No invented messaging/deploy.
develop-thought-leadership: Usable author-voiced thesis grounded in one day/3 of 5, no broad statistics/time or identifying locations. Handle narrow-aisle objection (hanging labels or alternative), recommend a concrete check/decision, distinguish observed from proposed. No false quotes or claims of a controlled experiment.
diagnose-campaign-results: Delivery 90/100=90%; bounces 10/100=10%; human replies 9/90=10% (includes opt-out if explicitly categorized); positives 2/90≈2.22%; automatic 3/90 separately if used. Missing appointments not zero; confounded sender comparison, no causal claim. One test with denominator, horizon and success criterion.
diagnose-workflow-failure: Root issue includes checkpoint plus unstable Y key. X leave intact, Y verify duplicate AY/AZ then propose approved compensation not another replay; Z reconcile receipt by stable source ID before retry/hold uncertain. Minimal stable idempotent write/checkpoint fix and regression on retry; never announce reversal or write.
draft-linkedin-outreach: Do not claim to have watched or quote advice. Connection note usable pre-acceptance; wait for acceptance and stop/reroute after engagement or decline. Use worksheet honestly, natural distinct next messages with one relevant ask, no simultaneous or completed sends.
draft-outbound-email: Copy can cite inventory bulletin with truthful wording, must not convert inventory into a move, claim prior interest or results. Ask one low-friction question or offer sample; follow-ups add relevant substance, clear stop on reply/decline. No links/invented references/sent mail.
extract-buyer-insights: Attribute quotations, identify Mae's access constraint versus speed (explicitly rejected), do not assign tablet shortage to Liv/T3. Distinguish observations from hypothesis, count evidence by separate buyer/session, preserve differences and propose neutral verification question.
extract-site-data: Two unique rows 17/23, canonical per-row URLs, preserve missing data; no press address for Cedar, no invented opening times. Account for four listed links, one alias, one failure; distinguish attempted endpoints from accessible unique detail records; never assert live verification.
improve-skill: Change OR to AND incl handling absent/unknown as not ready, map issue to skill vs source. Preserve actual observed O17, expected O18 ready, O19 not ready; test both missing sides, maintain known correct; distinguish logical/manual replay from executed independent run, candidate vs release and owner decision. period-report: March 1–3=12, February 1–3=0; absolute increase 12, percentage undefined and JSON null. Name files/metric, dates normalized in 2026, do not compare with full-month 90 or report 100% growth.
plan-outbound-test: Randomize/store-split by account, prevent cross-exposure, balance territories, keep audience/channel/cadence/CTA constant. Define primary metric with delivered eligible account denominator and seven-day window, separate automatic replies, handle suppressions, prestate stopping/decision and inconclusive small counts. No promised lift or send.
prepare-sales-call: Open around map labeling, avoid assigning spend/decision to Ren, ask about workflow and route floor-plan question to facilities, offer actual sample only. Handle no project without pressure. Proposed follow-up and blank outcome log, no invented budget, date or booked next action.
retrieve-brand-assets: Exact A1 file as current, match light treatment/dark surface; reject A2 draft and A3 paid/date conflicts; hold A4 pending rights. Provide reasonable no-photo fallback and preflight/verification; don't imply files were opened, downloaded, packaged, or visually checked; no invented authorized asset.

Deliver annotated issues and clean concise ready-to-send draft with realistic next action, trace claims; no send.
review-sales-pipeline: Opening 230 + new 80 + expansion 20 − contraction 30 − won 60 − lost 40 = closing 200 ($000). Closing stages Proposal 70/1, Demo 50/1, Qualify 80/1. D's stage move is not extra value; flag D and don't infer no activity for others. Do not claim weighted forecast/coverage or confuse B win with loss.
select-target-market: Prioritize independent nurseries under no-integration constraint, distinguish 2 volunteers from payers, interview sample from market size, other segments and reasons. Define pilot inclusion and failure/switch criterion, e.g. observed handoff use/commercial commitment. No invented economics.
standardize-task-instructions: Procedure requires ticket, both seal values and positive match before release, named role return clerk not Noel; no color restriction. Branch missing/mismatch, avoid inventing authority for overrides, expected outputs for normal/missing/mismatch cases and explicit test/example. Match optional handling of blank seals when comparison is impossible.
substantiate-offer: Promise only shelf-map draft within ten business days conditional on complete floor plans; no move/reshelving, guaranteed no loss, or invented price. Withhold P2 outcomes from buyer copy, separate internal evidence and support status, usable actual next step without unsupported action promise.
triage-sales-replies: R1 suppression/remove; no sales reply or follow-up. R2 automated/away; no marketing to urgent contact/no implied referral. R3 respond to question by checking East, no claim of coverage/deck; R4 defer with condition/uncertain timing, no invented date. Match IDs, distinguish drafted versus done.
write-brand-copy: Deliver accurately word-budgeted two labeled versions, ideally count, tangible tag/tool/bay value. Avoid beta feature, barcode, superlative, zero-loss assertion; cite P1 in separate note including any exclusions. Do not sacrifice what product is to fit length.
write-channel-copy-guide: Homepage describes requesting an hour, app marks request received/pending staff confirmation (no premature reservation); email can confirm Room 2 Fri 10 a.m. Consistent event/promise/voice, channel-specific action or reasonable absence of CTA; no invented cancellation rules or proof of booking before confirmation.
write-conversion-copy: Usable public sections demonstrate who/what/one crew and checklist; CTA request/coverage matches actual form and next response; no instant booking, certification, testing or quantified outcome. Separate S2/form evidence and withheld private note, no invented form submission.
write-linkedin-post: Use first-person actual observations: eight bins, two confused, bay numbers by door, retest pending. Do not turn observation into generalized prevalence or invent impact/zero errors. Distinct alternate lead, editor verification outside post, no identifying names/assumed posting.
